_doc: 適用技法ログ (manifest)。動画生成時に『どの岡田原則/技法を・どのtimestampに・どんなdirectiveとして適用したか』を残し、公開後にAnalyticsのretention曲線とt_start/t_endでjoinして瞬間単位のattributionを行うための台帳。schemaは_schemaを参照。

_schema.join_key: segments[].t_start / t_end (秒、累積) を YouTube Analytics の retention曲線・most-replayed の elapsedVideoTimeRatio と突き合わせる

taxonomies.framework_codes: script独自の構造taxonomy (SCRIPT_FRAMEWORK の H=hook / R=reversal / E=evidence / C=curiosity / M=meta / L=longform)。script.json の okada_meta をそのまま保持
taxonomies.okada_principles: visual-methodology/PRINCIPLES.md の原則1-8。PLAYBOOK/axis への逆引きと学習更新はこちらで行う。framework_codes からの mapping は backtest_report §2 準拠

segment_fields.heading: section見出し
segment_fields.framework_codes: script.json okada_meta をそのまま転記
segment_fields.okada_principles: 適用した PRINCIPLES 原則# の配列 (学習loopの主keyタクソノミー)
segment_fields.directives: [{type: Visual|Pacing|Audio, text, technique}]。type=技法カテゴリ、technique=axis anchor (判明分のみ)
segment_fields.intent: その segment で何を狙ったか (1文)
segment_fields.retention: 公開後に Analytics から充填。未公開は null

known_gaps: Pacing directive がほぼ全 segment で欠落 (冒頭 hook のみ hold指定あり)。backtest_report 改善3/5 が指摘した点。manifestがこの欠落を構造的に可視化している
technique (axis anchor) は backtestで確認済みの分のみ。未マッピングは null
duration は estimate。実publish後は actual に置換する

video.title: Why the Best Advice You've Ever Heard Was Almost Certainly Wrong (Survivorship Bias, Deeper Than You Think)

segments.heading: HOOK — The planes that came back

directives.text: WW2 bomber silhouette from above, red dots accumulating over wings/tail/fuselage; engines & cockpit stay clean and pulse with a faint warning glow
Hold the wide shot through the entire hook; dots accumulate in sync with narration escalation

segments.intent: 抽象を一枚絵に圧縮し冒頭離脱を防ぐ + 後で意味が反転する小物を冒頭に置く (原則2+1+8)

segments.heading: What Everybody Already Believes

directives.text: Intimate montage: founder biography page-turn, fitness influencer phone screen, podcast commuter → dissolve to low-light tribal campfire with empty mats (missing hunters made visible)

segments.intent: 観客の既存信念を入口で肯定し、300k年進化callbackを伏線化 (原則1)。『Hold that, we'll come back』で補完欲求を仕込む (原則3 deferral=C2 #1)

segments.heading: The First Reversal — Abraham Wald

directives.text: Hangar of damaged-but-intact bombers → zoom on Wald's hand-drawn statistical diagram → dissolve to empty gray North Atlantic with a plane outline fading beneath the surface (the missing planes) → academic journal covers flash

segments.intent: 表層の常識読み(穴に装甲)を統計で裏返す(原則1 R4)。bomber を再context化し『証拠』として再提示(原則2)。1943 Wald の歴史接続(原則7)

segments.heading: The Industries That Feed On It

directives.text: Bookstore business hardcovers top-down → camera tilts through table to underground archive of dust-covered REJECTED/BANKRUPT/FORGOTTEN manuscripts → phone feed UI: top videos at million scale tapering to hidden long tail → on-screen 'Layer 1/2/3' counter

segments.intent: 重い構造批判を『業界が餌にしている』として段階escalation(原則4 包む/L7)。marketing『that is the product』で善悪を固定しない(原則5)。『まだ最深層に達していない』で未体験を残す(原則8/C2 #2)

segments.heading: The Decisions This Is Ruining

directives.text: Split screen: left a lit TED-style podium, right a long dim row of empty podiums for those who never made it → single coin mid-flip ('one heads') → narrator's hand setting down folded 'my investing notebook, 2014'

segments.intent: 美談を構造批判に反転(R6)、『survivor cannot tell signal from noise』で善悪/被害者性を固定しない(原則5)。反論先回り(C5)。『I am going to admit something』自己開示で防衛解除し重さを包む(原則4/C8)

segments.heading: The Deepest Layer — Why More Knowledge Cannot Fix This

directives.text: Tracking shot through stylized ancestral plain (fire, mats, linger on an empty mat) → dissolve to endless curated success feed → brain-scan overlay on pattern-recognition areas → stylized YouTube card appears as narrator breaks fourth wall ('this video is also a survivor')

segments.intent: 最大の反転=進化論的frame(R9/原則7 神話・歴史)。全層を進化architectureに昇格(原則1の決定打)。『this video is also a survivor』meta asideで未体験/再帰を残す(原則8/M7)

segments.heading: What the Ritual Actually Is

directives.text: Chalkboard: erase a single dramatic upward success curve, replace with scattered grey dots (most low); finger circles the empty space below where unseen dots sit. Per-ritual icons: denominator fraction / coffee-shop interview / tombstone pre-mortem worksheet / question mark crossing out a self-help paperback

segments.intent: actionable処方(C12 4 rituals)。抽象な対策を具象アイコンに落とす(原則2)。tone shiftで加速

segments.heading: OUTRO
segments.intent: Zeigarnik loop『どの信念がplanes that came backに乗っているか』未解決の問いをコメント駆動に(原則8/C7)。次動画(政治版)のseed
